cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Affectionate Resentment
cards.instruction: Remain warm and familiar while letting old resentment sharpen beneath every caring gesture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may take the warm side, love. I've made sure something's ready after your taxi wait. I do remember how waiting feels.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You could have picked me up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A fair suggestion, darling. I've approved another blanket instead. I remember waiting outside your office last Christmas.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I apologized. Could you warm my feet?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Both feet are approved. Come here, love; I'll warm them myself. No part of you should have to wait the forty minutes I did.
